execution.mcp_registration: Explicit CLI registration of the installed Seamark binary, required=true. The fixture also received seamark init --skills=codex --approve-tools.
execution.preparation: Fresh generated fixture for every prompt. Apply the exact naive backend patch for the five review prompts before init/index; leave the generated client unchanged. Restore init changes to .gitignore and exclude benchmark scaffolding through .git/info/exclude.

measurement.activation: Successful read of a SKILL.md, established from completed command events and returned frontmatter; mentions and directory listings alone do not count.
measurement.seamark_calls: Completed MCP tool calls plus explicit Seamark CLI invocations, recorded separately. A nonzero command exit is retained as an attempted call. Help-only CLI invocations carry help_only=true.
measurement.usage: Codex turn.completed usage. cached_input_tokens is a subset of input_tokens; reasoning_output_tokens is a subset of output_tokens. Dollar cost is not returned by this ChatGPT-authenticated CLI run.
measurement.scope: Local-environment activation cohort. Personal skill exclusions were incomplete: review-before-pr also loaded review-code. These results do not establish isolation from personal skill metadata.
measurement.additional_skill_rule: An additional skill on a should-activate prompt is recorded separately; false activation is measured only on the four should-not prompts.

excluded_setup_attempts.reason: Initial restricted launch failed to initialize the Codex app-server/state database before thread.started; no model session ran. Retried in a fresh fixture with host launch access.
